description: Land Acquisition - Malgammana, Yatinuwara D/S DIvision, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes a specific parcel of land to be acquired by the government, provides its detailed description and boundaries, lists the claimants with an interest in the land, and outlines the legal procedure for claiming compensation. The content is entirely focused on land and property matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
